# Momentum #001-B: Incremental Forward Return Supplement

Post-validation descriptive exploration. 2017?2019 is already-seen data. No final test executed or changed.

## Methodology

Frozen 300 securities; L=5,20,60; minimum 100 pairs. Intervals use endpoint offsets (1,6), (6,11), (11,21), (21,61) relative to signal t. Existing momentum and forward-return functions are reused without modification. Up to 60 pre-period rows warm factors only. Missing history/endpoints remain NaN. Each named period independently bounds both endpoints. Common samples intersect all factor/interval pairs before recomputing average ranks, then intersect valid dates across all 12 combinations. Standard deviation uses ddof=1; ICIR is unannualized; positive fraction means IC>0. Annual statistics group signal years within their named bounded period.

![Incremental IC](../data/research/momentum_001B_incremental/heatmaps.png)

## Interpretation and limitations

Signs in the tables identify negative/positive associations; no interval is selected as optimal. Intervals are disjoint within a signal date, but returns still overlap across consecutive signal dates and share securities. Do not treat daily IC observations as independent. No significance tests, HAC bandwidth choices, backtesting or parameter optimization are performed. Multiple intervals, lookbacks, years, subperiods and samples create multiple comparisons. Current-constituent survivorship/selection bias, IPO histories, missing endpoints and vendor adjustments remain. The 2010 start has no pre-period history in the snapshot; initial factors are undefined. Boundaries exclude the final 6,11,21,61 rows respectively. Missing data are never filled.


## Observed profiles and verification

The pooled 5D relationship attenuates in later intervals; days 21?60 are near zero and change sign between available and common samples. In 2017?2019, 5D and 20D are negative in the first three intervals but positive in days 21?60; 60D is positive throughout. Thus negative cumulative returns can combine early negative association with later positive association. These are descriptive correlations, not additive effects or significance claims.

![Common-sample comparison](../data/research/momentum_001B_incremental/comparison.png)

All 149 offline tests passed, including endpoint and common-mask synthetic tests. Saved endpoints and minimum counts were checked; incremental and prior cumulative common retained dates match in every period. All original #001-A and #001-B manifests remain valid.
